title: The first hour after you wake up *decides* your whole day

head: Your first hour, minute by minute

items.head: Phone stays on airplane mode
items.sub: The first thing you see shouldn't be other people's lives.

items.head: Drink 500ml of water
items.sub: You just went 8 hours without any. Fix that first.

items.head: Make your bed
items.sub: Your first win of the day takes 60 seconds.

items.head: Get outside for 10 minutes
items.sub: Morning light wakes you up better than coffee does.

items.head: Move your body
items.sub: Gym, pushups or a fast walk. Just get your heart rate up.

items.head: Eat a real breakfast
items.sub: Eggs, not energy drinks. Protein keeps you sharp till lunch.

items.head: Write the 3 things that matter today
items.sub: Decide your day before the world decides it for you.

items.head: Now you can open your phone
items.sub: You already won the morning. Nothing in there can take it back.

head: Win the first hour. *The rest gets easier.*
sub: Save this and try it tomorrow.
